d1017_comparison.comparison_result: The p.188 global assertion repeats exactly the p.185 defect in every derived degree. Degree p=0 is the already disproved Hom assertion. I000032 is unit-specific and closed, so it must not be silently broadened or rewritten.

counterexample.space: The Sierpinski space X={x,u} with nonempty proper open U={u}.
counterexample.ring_sheaf: A(X)=Q[t], A(U)=M_2(Q), with restriction t mapped to e_11.
counterexample.strict_inclusion: t lies in Z(Gamma(X,A)) but not in Gamma(X,Z_A), because e_11 is not central in M_2(Q).
counterexample.degree_zero_failure: For F=G=A, multiplication by e_11 on the target is not A|_U-linear: with a=e_12 and s=1, e_11*a*s=e_12 while a*e_11*s=0.
counterexample.conclusion: The larger global center cannot supply the claimed canonical action in general, already for Ext^0=Hom.

corrected_derived_statement.center_sheaf: Z_A(U) consists of sections z in A(U) whose restriction to every V subset U commutes with every section of A(V). It is a sheaf of commutative rings and is the source's corrected A^natural.
corrected_derived_statement.global: For every p>=0, Ext_A^p(X;F,G)=Ext^p_{Mod(A)}(F,G) is canonically a module over Gamma(X,Z_A).
corrected_derived_statement.sheaf: For every p>=0, SheafExt_A^p(F,G)=R^p SheafHom_A(F,-)(G) is canonically a sheaf of Z_A-modules.
corrected_derived_statement.naturality: Both actions are functorial contravariantly in F and covariantly in G, and in degree zero they are the actions already proved by modules-lemma-sheaf-hom-left-modules.
corrected_derived_statement.specialization: If Gamma(X,Z_A) -> Z(Gamma(X,A)) is an equality, then the global action may equivalently be stated over Z(Gamma(X,A)); this holds in particular when A is commutative.
corrected_derived_statement.guard: No action by the larger ring Z(Gamma(X,A)) is asserted without that equality.

proof_dependencies.label: modules-lemma-sheaf-hom-left-modules
proof_dependencies.role: Defines Z_A, proves the Z_A-action on SheafHom, the Gamma(X,Z_A)-action on Hom, the canonical inclusion into Z(Gamma(X,A)), and the strict-inclusion counterexample.

proof_dependencies.label: modules-lemma-abelian
proof_dependencies.role: The category of sheaves of modules is abelian; the same proof applies to left modules over a possibly noncommutative sheaf of rings.

proof_dependencies.label: injectives-lemma-sheaves-modules-space
proof_dependencies.role: Supplies functorial injective resolutions; its stalkwise proof uses arbitrary left modules and does not require commutativity.

proof_dependencies.label: derived-lemma-left-exact-higher-derived
proof_dependencies.role: Makes the cohomology of the Hom and sheaf-Hom complexes the canonical right-derived functors.

proof_dependencies.label: derived-lemma-compute-ext-resolutions
proof_dependencies.role: Identifies the global Hom-complex cohomology with categorical Ext.
